title: Bob Beck at Ossining during the space kids experiments

tellings.quote: the story, like this guy Bob Beck, who was who was most certainly CIA, who was at the at Ossining at the time of these exact space kids experiments.

plain: A man named Bob Beck, who an unnamed researcher on the show says was "most certainly CIA", was in Ossining, New York, at the very time of what the guest calls the "space kids" experiments of the 1970s. The guest tells Michels this without naming a source, in an episode about a CIA scientist said to have contacted an alien council. The point is that the CIA may have been quietly present at those experiments.
